forbid.name: client.subscribe
forbid.note: MEASURED VIOLATION: graphql.rs OPERATION_PATTERNS has an ungated `client.subscribe(`, so an mqtt.js subscriber mints a phantom graphql_op:client.subscribe. GRAPHQL_OPERATION is not one of this mechanism's kinds, so matrix.py does NOT charge this to the cell; grade.py still reports it

note: A15.8 baseline 2026-09-17: NONE via=eventbus (extract 0/2) -- the only messaging nodes are event_emit/event_handle:sensors/temp and their EVENT_FLOWS pair, plus the phantom GraphQL operation. `event_handle:connect` is NOT forbidden: the mqtt.js client is an EventEmitter and `connect` is its real lifecycle event. Keyed on QUEUE_* + QUEUE_FLOWS like every A15.7 messaging cell, including the eventbus-first mechanisms (sqs_sns, azure_sb, redis, mqtt), so TypeScript/Java/C# read on the same scale as Python/Go and an EVENT_* key cannot flip to `none` when A2.9 moves broker pub/sub out of eventbus.rs. `via` still records the eventbus path when that is what fired. Measured against the installed wheel at HEAD bc42921.
